info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Inventory Distribution API
info.description: The Product Inventory Distribution API allows users to retrieve detailed information on product inventory across various channels. This API provides insights into product availability and distribution patterns, enabling businesses to make informed inventory decisions. Typical consumers include retail managers and supply chain analysts who require real-time data to optimize stock levels and respond to market demands. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their inventory management processes and improve overall operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve product inventory distribution by channel.
get.description: This API endpoint allows you to fetch the distribution of product inventory across different channels. It provides insights into inventory levels, helping businesses make informed decisions regarding stock management and distribution strategies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the product inventory distribution for a specific channel. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included in the body to accurately reflect the desired channel's inventory details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the product inventory distribution.

GetChannelSpecificProductInventoryDistri.description: A string representing the request body for fetching the product inventory distribution for a specific channel.
